body:
I heard a lot of drama about how dangerous pcp is, and I don't doubt that it is in the long run, as with most drugs.  I've had experience with other psychedelics [lsd, mushrooms] and dissociatives [ketakine, dxm] but pcp to me was very much like my first acid trips.  Heightened senses, a certain clarity, somewhat profound realizations, ect.  I don't recommend any drug, and by looking at the sherm heads on the corner bugging out I see that it's dangerous, but my first pcp experience was pleasant with no bad side effects.  There is however, a loss of coordination similar to mushrooms or being drunk, and I found myself staring at nothing.  Bottom line is very similar to lsd in my opinion.
